decisions.reason: As a software platform for building GIS solutions, close to the firm's core and given its own page in 2019, it embodies substantial investment and is central to the announced direction of integrated enterprise geospatial solutions, so management will persist with it.

Mobile field data capture fits the firm's established integrated offering and was consistently presented on its own page, so sunk development effort and public commitment favor keeping it, and any weak uptake can be attributed to temporary market conditions.

The smart search extension was actively versioned (1.6.0) and publicly promoted as part of the map.apps ecosystem, and continued investment and visible commitment make dropping it unlikely despite the earlier pruning of smaller plugins.
